ios.desc:
Who does not know it. Whether you are the questioner yourself or have to answer this question regularly. Everyone has probably heard it. It is probably the most common, recurring question in a household, and there is currently no automated answer to it. 

UNTIL NOW!

Because coopes! solves exactly this problem. Through the app, all cooperators of a meal plan are kept up to date on the planned meals at all times

You can create recipes and combine them into planned meals. Changes are shown in real time to all cooperators.

With drag and drop you can move or swap planned meals.

The ingredient list provides you with a summary of all required ingredients at any time.

quotes.text: Coopes is exactly what you are thinking about. There is a one time purchase available to enable a sync feature with family members, otherwise it is completely free: https://apps.apple.com/de/app/coopes-der-essensplan/id1555086478
